darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 129: adds REX/RX2/RCY preview and editing, RX2 loop/trim drag export, vertical waveform zoom, and Project Audio Export to a DAW folder or ZIP. Also includes improved long-audio playback, metadata columns, LOOP/ONESHOT and filename BPM fixes, and updated FFmpeg license/source notices.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 231: restores LOOP/ONESHOT classification in existing analyzed libraries and reads explicit filename BPM amid other numbers. Also includes PITCH double-click reset and digit-only entry.
